description_en: 🏗️ 1+1 Apartment for Sale - Viva Residence ✨ 📍 Location: Behind Globe, at the former Bus Park ☀️ Orientation: West - natural lighting and open view all afternoon 📐 Total area: 62.9 m² + veranda 13.8 m² 🧱 Construction phase: At the beginning of the brick phase ⏳ Completion: Within 18 months 💶 Total price: €122,150 (62.9 m² × €1,750/m² + veranda 13.8 m² × €875/m²) 🏡 A perfect choice for living or long-term investment, in a modern residence with high construction standards, thermal and acoustic insulation, green spaces and contemporary infrastructure.
